interfaces.name: mouth_servo

interfaces.name: lens_tube
interfaces.what: Ø15.0 open-arch CRADLE on the -x face, axis x through (y 0.000000, z 7.500000): a free-centre circle fitted to the mesh VERTICES reads Ø15.000000 at every one of the four x stations that carry them (-39.5000, -37.5000, -36.5000, -35.5000; 31 unique vertices each, identical to 8 dp at 15.00000018, residual max 0.0000007 mm), swept 149.06-149.09 deg, chord plane z 9.5000, crown z 15.0000, outer surface Ø17.400000. RE-MEASURED 2026-09-03: the Ø14.9938 / 14.9954 / 14.9978 and Ø17.3926 published on 2026-09-02 came from meshslice cross-section fits, whose point sets mix facet corners with edge-interpolated points and read one half-sagitta (0.0039 mm) small. Two ring bands x -39.5000..-37.5000 (2.0000 mm) and -36.5000..-35.5000 (1.0000 mm) with 1.0000 mm of Ø16.800000 relief between. It cradles the 15x10x3 bearing's Ø15.0 OUTER RACE; the jaw's Ø10.000000 journal (centre y 0.000000, z 7.500000, x -39.7000..-37.0000) turns in its bore. Cradle and journal are coaxial to better than 0.0000010 mm — their vertex-fitted axes differ by 0.000000031 mm, below either fit's own residual, so this is bounded by the instrument rather than resolved by it (the 0.0005 mm published on 2026-09-02 was the difference between two chord-fit centres). Cradle and the Ø15.000000 bearing race are LINE-TO-LINE: diametral gap 0.0000 mm, no interference. CORRECTED 2026-09-02 (lane T): this row previously called the feature the camera lens / lens-holder seat and that is REFUTED by measurement — in this same frame m12_lens_holder sits at y -52.38..-37.58 and lens at y -63.8..-44.88, a different axis 37-64 mm away, and neither carries any Ø15 surface (barrel Ø11.6 / 13.6 / 16.94). 210.94 deg of the arch is open air below the chord and NOTHING in any of Pollen's four MJCF files closes it, so retention here is CANNOT DETERMINE.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's motor_support.stl and jaw.stl by cecad.meshslice circle fits at five x stations, cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders and cecad.meshfeatures.intervals (ray-cast at radius 8.100 mm), plus the MJCF body/geom composition that places the bearing and the jaw in this frame; frozen in ce-connections/press-fit-tube-15/iterations/v0.0.1/evidence/tube-15-geometry.json, 2026-09-02
interfaces.name_is_legacy_why: the name 'lens_tube' is kept because cad/part.py line 262 builds a connector of that name; the ROLE and the text below are the measurement. connection:press-fit-tube-15 compat.py carries `claims_a_lens_seat` as the regression guard.
